_comment: Shared folder settings. Read by BOTH scripts/generate-images.py and
js/autoscan.js, so the two can never disagree about a folder's name or
whether it belongs in the gallery.
A folder NOT listed here still works: it joins the gallery with its own
name as the tab label. You only need an entry to override that.
label   - gallery tab wording. "" keeps the folder out of the gallery.
gallery - false keeps it out even if it has a label.
alt     - fallback photo description. {site} becomes the resort name.
galleryOrder lists the tab order. Folders not named here go last,
_formats: Which file types count as a photo. Read by BOTH scripts/generate-images.py
and js/autoscan.js so the two can never disagree — a format listed in one
but not the other would show up locally and then vanish after a build.
source        - everything accepted when you drop files in.
browserSafe   - what a browser can display directly. Anything in `source`
but NOT in `browserSafe` (a .heic straight off an iPhone,
a .tif from a photographer) is converted to JPEG during
the build, and the converted copy is what the page uses.
HEIC needs the pillow-heif package. Without it those files are skipped
with a clear message rather than silently producing a broken image.
